def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the value of mode, then the value of level, then the values of
    any other keys in the order they first appear in keys. If a key repeats,
    the last value given for it wins.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
    ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
    ex settings(["x", "y", "x"], ["1", "2", "3"]) == ["fast", "3", "3", "2"]
    ex settings(["mode", "level"], ["a", "b"]) == ["a", "b"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    others: list[str] = []
    vals: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k not in vals:
                others.append(k.copy())
            vals[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k in others:
        out.append((vals.get(k) else "").copy())
    return out
